C1099.title: Hangzhou Police Crack AI Face-Swapping Account Theft Case
C1099.summary: In 2024, Hangzhou police in Zhejiang Province cracked a case involving AI face-swapping technology used to bypass facial recognition systems and steal e-commerce accounts. The criminal gang compromised over 150 accounts, generating illicit profits exceeding 100,000 yuan.
